sections.title: BotFleet Add-Ons
sections.sub: Everything this fork layered on after OpenMausBot.  All of these are in testing — they run in daily use on this fleet, they are not a finished product surface, and they can still change.

features.title: Always-On iMessage Relay
features.desc: A host daemon plus LaunchAgents keep bot group chats in Messages.app wired to the BotFleet backend in both directions while the relay is running.

features.title: iOS Companion on Public TestFlight
features.desc: Pairing, universal links on botfleet.app, App Groups, thread tabs, unread Live Activities, and display-aware transcript windows.  Alerts are SSE plus local notifications while the companion is open.  A killed or backgrounded app wakes over APNs when the Mac sidecar is running.  iPad still runs in compatibility mode.

features.title: Nested Conversations Under Channels
features.desc: Renameable task threads live under their channel, can be moved, searched, and collapsed, with a custom word for room if you want one.

features.title: Chat Bubble & Request ID Copy Controls
features.desc: Click any user or bot message bubble to copy its text.  Hover for a dedicated copy button with right-click options to copy the Request ID or Message ID.

features.title: macOS Menu Bar Tray
features.desc: A menu-bar extra keeps BotFleet reachable while the window is hidden.

features.title: System Auto Default & Readable Code Fences
features.desc: First visit uses System Auto, which follows this computer — Studio in light, Midnight in dark.  Other skins stay explicit picker rows.  Code fences pick a Shiki theme that stays readable on the painted skin.  Includes update toggle preferences and in-app banner controls.

features.title: Always-On Harness Attach
features.desc: The desktop app attaches to an already-running BotFleet harness instead of forking a second one.

features.title: Native DeepSeek Engine & Pricing Breakdown
features.desc: Native API and ACP drivers for DeepSeek models, complete with an in-app model rates and token pricing reference in Settings.

features.title: Gemini & Antigravity Engines
features.desc: Gemini 3.8 Flash plus Antigravity, with full tool loading and local computer dispatch on those harnesses after opt-in.

features.title: Multi-Tier Model Fallback Chains
features.desc: Assign 1st, 2nd, and 3rd choice fallback models to each bot.  Quota, usage-cap, and session-limit chips fail over automatically, including after tools already ran and in rooms.  Other streamed error paths are still in review.

features.title: Elapsed Turn Timer
features.desc: A live timer on the in-progress turn, plus duration on completed activity runs.

features.title: Usage Telemetry & Central Accounting
features.desc: Live token consumption (prompt, completion, cache hits) and model costs stream to a Usage Monitor instance you configure, with automatic project and repo classification.

features.title: Provider Marks & Picker Filtering
features.desc: Official-style marks for Grok, Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini/Antigravity, and others.  Unconfigured models stay out of the picker.

features.title: Fleet Recall
features.desc: Bots search and contribute to a shared memory store instead of a private hash-proxy index.

features.title: Fleet MCP Tools
features.desc: List and answer approvals, open_app, routines, webhooks, decision-log tools, and idempotent sends for external MCP clients.

features.title: Multi-Repo Channels & Interactive File Links
features.desc: Channels can attach multiple repositories with automatic context injection.  Local file links open in default Mac apps with 1 click or reveal in Finder on Option-click.

features.title: Resource-Threshold Triggers
features.desc: Sample local disk, RAM/swap, and optional CPU load while BotFleet is running and enqueue the same kind of task a routine would when a threshold is crossed.

features.title: TryCloudflare, Tailscale, and Custom Domains
features.desc: A free *.trycloudflare.com URL from Settings, Tailscale MagicDNS for phone linking, or a Cloudflare token for a custom domain.  Custom webhook ingress can sit on its own domain with token validation.

features.title: Mid-Task Crash & Restart Recovery
features.desc: Interrupted turns and mid-flight tool executions are automatically detected on boot, prompting immediate resumption instead of leaving tasks stuck in an unknown state.

features.title: One-Command TestFlight Ship
features.desc: Automated signing, archiving, and TestFlight upload pipeline from the Mac build environment.
